answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed on proven misbehavior, turning fake identities from free into costly. Reputation then grows only through verified work over time, like an orchard that yields fruit season after season rather than overnight. A public audit log acts as a lantern, exposing clusters of accounts that share funding sources or identical behavior patterns, while umber-colored risk scores flag suspicious newcomers for extra review before they can transact at full volume.
